title: Microsoft Artifact Registry Container Images Empty Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Microsoft Artifact Registry Container images. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the default credentials set within the image. The issue results from the use of empty root password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
